meta.name: treasury-and-liquidity
meta.description: Manages cash and liquidity — cash forecasting, runway, working capital, banking structure, and currency and counterparty exposure. Use this to build a cash forecast, extend runway, improve working capital, decide where cash should sit, or assess exposure to a bank, currency, or customer concentration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测现金流，优化营运资金，保障资金安全。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责企业资金管理，需要做现金规划和风险评估。
copy.tagline_en: Plan cash flows, optimize working capital, and manage liquidity risk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage corporate treasury and need to plan cash flows and control liquidity risk.

howto.what: Claude会按周直接预测现金收支,并与上周预测对比;按计划、营收不及预期、大额回款延迟等情景计算资金可撑多久;也会检查应收/应付/库存,提示现金放置和银行/货币/客户集中风险。
howto.when: 当用户要求做现金预测、算现金跑道、改善营运资金等,或评估对某家银行、某种货币、某类客户的风险集中度时触发。

say.text: 帮我按周做未来十三周的直接收款与付款预测。
say.note: 会输出按周的现金预测表与假设。

say.text: 对比上周的现金预测和本周实际,分析差异。
say.note: 会指出误差原因并修正模型。

say.text: 按计划、营收不及预期、大额回款延迟三种情景算现金跑道。
say.note: 会给出各情景跑道天数和决策日期。

howto.what_en: Claude will build a direct weekly cash forecast, compare it to prior forecasts, model how long cash lasts under base/downside/large-receivable-slip scenarios, review receivables/payables/inventory for working capital, and flag bank/currency/customer concentration risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a cash forecast, extend the cash runway, improve working capital, or assess concentration risk to a bank, currency, or customer.

say_en.text: Build a weekly direct cash forecast of receipts and disbursements for 13 weeks.
say_en.note: You'll get a weekly cash forecast with assumptions.

say_en.text: Compare last week's cash forecast with actuals and explain the variance.
say_en.note: You'll see where the forecast missed and how to adjust.

say_en.text: Run runway scenarios: base, revenue shortfall, and a large receivable slip.
say_en.note: You'll get runway days and decision dates for each scenario.
